summary.zh: 搭事务邮件模板并接入发送服务
summary.en: Build transactional email templates and provider setup

description.zh: 做注册、找回密码、订单通知这类事务邮件：模板结构、预览、多语言、深色模式与送达率处理，并接上 Resend、Postmark、SendGrid 或 SES。适合从零搭邮件系统或重做模板时使用，需要在所选服务商开通账号并配置密钥。
description.en: Builds transactional email end to end: templates for signup, password reset and order notices, previews, i18n, dark mode and deliverability, wired to Resend, Postmark, SendGrid or SES. A provider account and API key are required.
